$comment: 语法大厅 G25（V0.9 P2a 骨架层）。比喻锚点：声部对齐，不能一个人抢拍——谓语声部必须跟领唱（主语）对齐。八课亲戚 L1（be 对齐表）与 L3（三单 -s）。暗线本层第二次正面出场：be 是英语最常用的动词，偏偏保留最多形态（am/is/are/was/were...）——越常用越不规则。全部内容原创。
title: 主谓一致
metaphor: 声部对齐，不能一个人抢拍
ketNote: Part 5 填空先看主语数人头再选动词形；everyone 单数、and 复数、剥洋葱找真主语是三大盯防点。八课里的亲戚是 L1 和 L3。

sections.essence: 声部对齐：谓语跟着领唱（主语）走——单数配单数，复数配复数。
sections.why: 中文的动词从不看主语脸色：「他住北京」「他们住北京」——「住」纹丝不动。英语的谓语却像合唱里的声部，必须跟领唱（主语）对齐：He lives，They live；The milk is，The apples are。对不齐，就是有人抢拍——句子立刻刺耳。规则本身你早认识：be 的对齐表是 G04 的老朋友（am/is/are，过去 was/were），三单 -s 是 G06 的老朋友。这一课真正要练的是三件新事：一是「数人头」——and 连起来的算复数，everyone/each 明明感觉是「大家」却按单数算，不可数名词永远单数；二是「剥洋葱找领唱」——The boy with two dogs is...，谓语要对齐的是 boy，不是离得近的 dogs，长戏服最会骗人；三是 There be 的就近原则。Part 5 里动词形选错，十有八九是人头数错了。
sections.metaphorStory: 合唱排练，指挥忽然敲停：「第二声部，你们抢拍了。」原来领唱唱的是慢板，第二声部却按快板跟——两边没对齐，整首歌散了架。指挥说：「合唱的铁律：所有声部跟着领唱走。句子也一样——主语是领唱，谓语是跟唱的声部，单数配单数，复数配复数：He sings，They sing；The milk is fresh，The apples are sweet。」有团员问：「要是领唱身边围了一圈人呢？」指挥笑了：「那就更要看清谁是领唱。The boy with two dogs is my neighbour——领唱是 boy，那两只狗只是他带来的『装饰』，声部别跟错了人。还有几个容易数错的：Tom and Amy 手拉手上台，那是两个人——are；everyone 听着像『大家』，其实是一个一个点名——按单数算，Everyone is here；牛奶、米饭这些数不清的，永远按单数。」最后他压低声音：「最不讲理的还是 be——别的动词只在三单加个 s，它一个词摆出 am、is、are、was、were 五副面孔。为什么？它是全英语最常用的动词。你们早知道那条暗线了——越常用的词，越不规则。」

cards.rule: 总规则：谓语跟领唱对齐
cards.detail: 单数主语配单数动词（三单 -s / is / was），复数主语配复数动词（原形 / are / were）。只有一般现在时和 be 需要对齐。
cards.example: He lives here. / They live here. / She was late. / We were late.

cards.detail: 两个主语手拉手上台，就是两个人。
cards.example: Tom and Amy are in the choir.

cards.detail: 听着像「大家」，其实是挨个点名——语法上按单数算。something/anything 也一样。
cards.example: Everyone is here. / Each student has a songbook.

cards.detail: milk、water、homework、news 这些数不清的，谓语一律按单数配。学科名 maths/physics 带着化石 s，也是单数。
cards.example: The milk is fresh. / Maths is my favourite.

cards.detail: 主语身后的长戏服（of.../with.../in...）不参与对齐——谓语只认领唱本人。
cards.example: The boy with two dogs is my neighbour. / The colour of the flowers is lovely.

cards.detail: 报幕句的 be 跟离它最近的那个名词对齐。
cards.example: There is a pen and two books on the desk. / There are two books and a pen.

basic.cn: 我哥哥喜欢流行乐。（单数领唱配 likes）
我爸妈喜欢老歌。（复数配原形 like）
水现在是温的。（不可数按单数）
莉莉和本是同桌。（and＝两个人）

basic.en: Everyone is ready for the show.
basic.cn: 大家都准备好演出了。（everyone 按单数）

mid.en: The girl in white shoes runs fastest.
mid.cn: 穿白鞋的女孩跑得最快。（领唱是 girl，不是 shoes）

mid.en: The price of the tickets is thirty yuan.
mid.cn: 票价三十元。（领唱是 price）

mid.en: There is a map and two posters on the wall.
mid.cn: 墙上有一张地图和两张海报。（就近对齐 a map）

mid.en: Each of the players has a number.
mid.cn: 每个队员都有号码。（each 按单数）

mid.en: Maths is not hard if you practise.
mid.cn: 只要练，数学不难。（maths 的 s 是化石——单数）

trap.en: The news about the concert was exciting.
trap.cn: 音乐会的消息令人兴奋。
trap.note: news 不可数按单数——别被词尾的 s 和中间的戏服骗了。

trap.en: You were the first to arrive.
trap.note: you 永远配 are/were——哪怕只指一个人。

trap.en: Ten yuan is enough for the bus.
trap.note: 钱数、时间当「一笔／一段」整体看——按单数。

trap.en: My family has dinner together on Sundays.
trap.cn: 我家每周日一起吃晚饭。
trap.note: family 当一个整体——KET 里按单数处理最稳。

trap.en: The twins were born in spring.
trap.note: 过去时里只有 was/were 要对齐——其他动词过去式一视同仁。

trap.en: Everyone in the two classes knows this song.
trap.cn: 两个班的每个人都会这首歌。
trap.note: 领唱是 everyone（单数）——in the two classes 是戏服，别跟它对齐。

redBlack.bad: Her best friend live in Beijing.（想说她最好的朋友——一个人）
redBlack.good: Her best friend lives in Beijing.
redBlack.why: 动词的 s 是听者数人头的线索——谓语背叛主语，friend 还是 friends 就数不清了。

redBlack.bad: There is two pandas in the photo.
redBlack.good: There are two pandas in the photo.
redBlack.why: 报幕报了单数、上台来了一对——观众当场懵住（G05 的报幕规矩）。

redBlack.bad: Tom and his sister is coming to the party.
redBlack.good: Tom and his sister are coming to the party.
redBlack.why: and 手拉手上台——两个人，配 are。

redBlack.bad: Everyone are excited about the trip.
redBlack.good: Everyone is excited about the trip.
redBlack.why: everyone 是挨个点名——语法上单数，配 is。

redBlack.bad: The colour of these flowers are beautiful.
redBlack.good: The colour of these flowers is beautiful.
redBlack.why: 剥掉戏服 of these flowers——领唱是 colour，单数。

redBlack.bad: The milk in the fridge are still fresh.
redBlack.good: The milk in the fridge is still fresh.
redBlack.why: milk 不可数按单数——中间的戏服不改变领唱。

redBlack.bad: You was very brave just now.
redBlack.good: You were very brave just now.
redBlack.why: you 永远配 are/were——哪怕只指一个人。

redBlack.bad: Each student have a music book.
redBlack.good: Each student has a music book.
redBlack.why: each 挨个点名——按单数，have 变 has。
maths 词尾的 s 是化石——学科名按单数。

redBlack.bad: There are a piano and two drums in the room.
redBlack.good: There is a piano and two drums in the room.
redBlack.why: there be 就近对齐——紧挨着的是 a piano，用 is。

redBlack.bad: My family are watching TV.（英式常这么说）
redBlack.good: My family is watching TV.（KET 按单数最稳）
redBlack.why: 集体名词英式可按「一群人」配复数——意思不挡，考试按整体单数处理。

redBlack.bad: Two hours are a long time for kids.
redBlack.good: Two hours is a long time for kids.
redBlack.why: 时间、钱数当一段整体看按单数——错了意思也不挡，KET 少考。

contrast.cn: 他住北京。他们住北京。（「住」不变）
contrast.en: He lives in Beijing. / They live in Beijing.
contrast.diff: 中文动词从不看主语脸色；英语的谓语要跟领唱对齐——数完人头再开口。

contrast.cn: 大家都到了。（「大家」感觉是一群人）
contrast.diff: 中文的「大家」是集体感；英语的 everyone 是挨个点名——语法上一个一个算。

contrast.cn: 穿白鞋的女孩跑得快。（定语不影响什么）
contrast.en: The girl in white shoes runs fast.（对齐 girl 不对齐 shoes）
contrast.diff: 中文谓语不变形无所谓；英语要剥开戏服找领唱，别跟离得近的词对齐。

contrast.cn: 桌上有一支笔和两本书。（「有」不变）
contrast.en: There is a pen and two books on the desk.（就近对齐）
contrast.diff: 中文的「有」万年不变；英语报幕的 be 看紧挨着的第一个名词。

contrast.en: am / is / are / was / were——五副面孔。
contrast.diff: 英语最常用的 be 变形最多——越常用越不规则，这条暗线你已经见过很多次。

quickJudge.mnemonic: 先剥洋葱找领唱，再数人头定单复；and 算俩，everyone 算一，数不清的都算一。
steps: 找领唱：剥掉主语身后的戏服（of.../with.../in...），认准真主语。
数人头：and 连接 → 复数；everyone/each/nobody/something → 单数；不可数、学科名 → 单数。
对齐：一般现在时三单加 -s；be 查对齐表（am/is/are，过去 was/were）；you 永远配 are/were。
There be 句：跟紧挨着的第一个名词对齐。
过去时安检：除 was/were 外，其他动词过去式不用对齐——别多虑。

parentScript.script: 「宝贝，英语的句子像合唱：主语是领唱，动词是跟着的声部，必须对齐——一个人时动词穿单数衣服，一群人时穿复数衣服。咱们玩『数人头』：我说主语，你数完人头再接动词。Tom and Amy——几个人？（两个）所以是 are。Everyone——听着像大家，英语里却是挨个点名，算一个人，用 is。牛奶呢？数不清的都算一个。再玩『找领唱』：The boy with two dogs——领唱是男孩还是狗？动词只跟领唱对齐。我不懂英语没关系，我就问两句：领唱是谁？几个人？」听到她说 my friend live 或 everyone are，别急着纠正，先问「几个人？」让她自己对齐。
questions: Tom and Amy 算几个人？后面接 is 还是 are？
everyone 听着像「大家」，英语里为什么按一个人算？
The boy with two dogs ___ my neighbour. 领唱是谁？填 is 还是 are？

sections.echo: 为什么英语单单留下「主谓一致」这道工序？一千年前，英语动词每个人称都有专属词尾，密密麻麻一整张表；被日常口语磨了几百年，普通动词只剩三单 -s 这一处还要对齐——磨损从不均匀，最冷门的先磨平。可最常用的 be 偏偏是例外中的例外：一个词守着 am、is、are、was、were 五副面孔，是全英语变形最多的动词。道理你已经能自己讲出来了：be 每天被每个人念上几百遍，每一副老面孔都被使用擦得锃亮，谁也磨不掉它。越常用的词，越不规则——这是这条暗线在骨架层的第二次正面出场，而 be，是它最大的一枚证据。

memoryCard.alt: G25 记忆卡：主谓一致=声部跟领唱对齐；数人头（and 复数、everyone/each 单数、不可数单数）；剥洋葱找领唱（戏服不参与对齐）；There be 就近；警示 Everyone are、Tom and Amy is、You was。

questions.q: 「主谓一致」里，谓语跟谁对齐？
questions.explain: 所有声部跟领唱走——谓语只认主语。

questions.q: Tom and Amy 算几个人头？
everyone 在语法上按？
不可数名词（milk/water）的谓语按？
questions.explain: 数不清的都算一个——The milk is。

questions.q: each student 后面接？
The boy with two dogs ___ tall. 领唱是谁？
questions.explain: with two dogs 是戏服——对齐 boy。

questions.q: maths（数学）的谓语按？
questions.explain: 学科名的 s 是化石——Maths is。

questions.q: you 一个人时配哪个 be？
questions.explain: you 永远配 are/were——单复同款。

questions.q: There ___ a lamp and two chairs here. 就近对齐填？
news 的谓语按？
questions.explain: news 不可数——化石 s 别上当。

questions.q: 过去时里哪个动词还要对齐？
questions.explain: played 大家通用；be 分 was/were。

questions.q: nobody 后面接？
My parents ___ doctors.
The rice ___ in the bowl.
为什么 be 一个词有 am/is/are/was/were 五副面孔？
options: 它最常用，老形态都被用得磨不掉
questions.explain: 越常用的词越不规则——暗线的最大证据。

questions.q: Something ___ wrong with my bike.
My grandma ___ tai chi every morning.
The students in Class One ___ a show next week.
questions.explain: 领唱是 students（复数）——in Class One 是戏服。

questions.q: Bread and milk ___ my usual breakfast — 就当一套早餐说：
questions.explain: 面包牛奶合成「一套早餐」整体——is（成套的东西当一份）。

questions.q: Everyone in the choir ___ the new song already.
questions.explain: everyone 单数——knows；in the choir 是戏服。

questions.q: The keys on the piano ___ black and white.
Each of the singers ___ a solo part.
There ___ two windows and a door in the room.
The homework for these two days ___ easy.
My aunt and uncle ___ in Kunming.
Ten minutes ___ enough for a warm-up.
questions.explain: 十分钟当「一段时间」整体——is。

questions.q: The story of the four seasons ___ from an old song.
You ___ the winner last time, remember?
questions.explain: you 配 were——哪怕就你一个人。

questions.q: Nobody ___ the answer to this riddle.
The music from the speakers ___ too loud.
Both of my sisters ___ glasses.
Physics ___ interesting, says my cousin in Grade Nine.
哪句声部对齐了？
options: Tom and Jerry are always together.
Tom and Jerry is always together.
Tom and Jerry was always together.

questions.q: 哪句的 everyone 没抢拍？
options: Everyone is here, so let's begin.
Everyone are here, so let's begin.
Everyone were here, so let's begin.

questions.q: 哪句找对了领唱？
options: The smell of the flowers is sweet.
The smell of the flowers are sweet.
The smells of the flower is sweet.
questions.explain: 领唱是 smell——is；of the flowers 是戏服。

questions.q: 哪句的不可数对齐了？
options: The juice in these bottles is fresh.
The juice in these bottles are fresh.
The juices in these bottle are fresh.
questions.explain: juice 不可数——is；bottles 是戏服。

questions.q: 哪句的 you 没被冤枉？
options: You were the only one who came.
You was the only one who came.
You is the only one who came.

questions.q: 哪句的 each 对齐了？
options: Each window has a paper cutting.
Each window have a paper cutting.
Each windows has a paper cutting.

questions.q: 哪句的报幕就近对齐了？
options: There is a violin and two flutes in the case.
There are a violin and two flutes in the case.
There were a violin and two flutes in the case now.

questions.q: 哪句的化石 s 没骗到人？
options: The news makes us all happy.
The news make us all happy.
The new makes us all happy.

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（我的鞋在门口）
options: My shoes are at the door.
My shoes is at the door.
My shoe are at the door.（想说一双鞋）

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（每个人都有两分钟）
哪句写对了？（弹钢琴的那个男孩是我弟弟）
options: The boy at the piano is my little brother.
The boy at the piano are my little brother.
The boys at the piano is my little brother.（就一个男孩）

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（这套书是图书馆的）
options: This set of books belongs to the library.
This set of books belong to the library.
These set of books belongs to the library.

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（昨天你们都很棒）
questions.explain: 过去 + you——were；时态也要在调里。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（书包里有些好东西）
options: There is something nice in the schoolbag.
There are something nice in the schoolbag.
There have something nice in the schoolbag.

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（二十元不算贵）
questions.explain: 钱数整体——is；yuan 不加 s。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（我的家人都爱唱歌——按整体）
options: My families loves singing.（说自己一家）

questions.q: The leader of the drummers ___ the beat, and the others ___.
questions.explain: 领唱是 leader（单数）sets；others 复数 follow。

questions.q: Everyone ___ ready, but the lights ___ not on yet.
questions.explain: everyone 单数 is；lights 复数 are。

questions.q: There ___ a stage and forty seats, and each seat ___ a number.
questions.explain: 就近 a stage → is；each seat → has。

questions.q: The sound of the bells ___ over the hills, and everybody ___ to listen.
questions.explain: 领唱 sound 单数 floats；everybody 单数 stops。

questions.q: Tom and his cousin ___ the duet, and the audience ___ it a warm welcome.（audience 按整体）
questions.explain: and 复数 sing；audience 整体单数 gives。

questions.q: Maths ___ first on Monday, and the two music lessons ___ after lunch.
questions.explain: maths 单数 comes；two lessons 复数 come。

questions.q: The girl with the twin brothers ___ violin, and the twins ___ drums.
questions.explain: 领唱 girl 单数；twins 复数——戏服里的 brothers 不参与。

questions.q: Half an hour ___ left, and there ___ still three songs to practise.
questions.explain: 半小时整体 is；three songs 复数 are。

questions.q: Nobody ___ the old song, but everyone ___ to learn it.
The colour of the new uniforms ___ light blue, and the buttons ___ silver.
questions.explain: 领唱 colour 单数 is；buttons 复数 are。

questions.q: You ___ late yesterday, and the teacher ___ worried.
Each of the tickets ___ a seat number, and the numbers ___ by the doors.
questions.explain: each 单数 has；numbers 复数 are。

questions.q: The water in the two kettles ___ hot, and the cups ___ on the tray.
questions.explain: water 不可数 is；cups 复数 are。

questions.q: My family ___ front-row seats, and my parents ___ flowers for the singers.（family 按整体）
questions.explain: family 整体 has；parents 复数 have。

questions.q: There ___ good news for the band: the tickets ___ sold out!
questions.explain: news 单数 is；tickets 复数 are。

questions.q: 大考：The best part of the concerts ___ the encore, when everyone ___ up and the lights ___ golden.
questions.explain: 领唱 part 单数 is；everyone 单数 stands；lights 复数 turn——三处人头一次数清。

detective.sentence: My best friend live near the school.
detective.fixed: My best friend lives near the school.
detective.clue: friend 是单数领唱——谓语要穿三单的 s。

detective.sentence: Everyone in our class are learning this dance.
detective.fixed: Everyone in our class is learning this dance.
detective.clue: everyone 挨个点名按单数——in our class 是戏服，别跟它对齐。

detective.sentence: The price of these drums are too high.
detective.fixed: The price of these drums is too high.
detective.clue: 剥掉戏服 of these drums——领唱是 price，单数。

detective.sentence: Tom and his deskmate goes to the library after school.
detective.fixed: Tom and his deskmate go to the library after school.
detective.clue: and 手拉手上台是两个人——goes 的 s 要摘掉。

detective.sentence: You was the best dancer at the party last night.
detective.fixed: You were the best dancer at the party last night.
detective.clue: you 永远配 are/were——哪怕只指一个人。

detective.sentence: There are a whiteboard and six desks in the new room.
detective.fixed: There is a whiteboard and six desks in the new room.
detective.clue: 报幕就近对齐——紧挨着的是 a whiteboard，用 is。

detective.sentence: The news about the school trip make us excited.
detective.fixed: The news about the school trip makes us excited.
detective.clue: news 的 s 是化石，按单数——makes；中间的戏服不改变领唱。
